gaps.sentence: She put ___ money in the safe before leaving.
gaps.explanation: 'The money' and 'the safe' are specific in the situation.

gaps.sentence: He demands ___ answer before the end of the day.
She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He was sent to ___ prison for armed robbery.
gaps.explanation: 'Be sent to prison' (as a prisoner) takes no article; visiting the building is 'go to the prison'.

gaps.sentence: He behaves as if he were ___ owner of the company.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — there is one owner, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: I saw ___ film last night, and the film was about mountain climbers.
gaps.hint: first mention of one of many
gaps.explanation: First mention of a countable noun takes 'a'; the second mention becomes 'the' (already written out here).

gaps.sentence: ___ life in the countryside is much quieter.
gaps.explanation: 'Life' in a general sense takes no article: Life is hard sometimes.

gaps.sentence: ___ Hyde Park is lovely in autumn.
gaps.explanation: Most park names take no article: Hyde Park, Central Park (exception: the Grands Boulevards style names).
